title: Isa's Unicorn Flowers
hook: 独角兽的角上会开满小花，可是它想让妈妈也有花，于是 Dora 和 Isa 陪它一路去找白锥子，还得先让拦路的红龙让开。

cells.en: Dora and Isa are in the garden, and Isa says, “Great!”
cells.cn: Dora 和 Isa 在花园里，Isa 说：“太棒了！”

cells.en: A white unicorn asks, “Would you like some flowers for your mommy?”
cells.cn: 一只白色独角兽问：“你想带些花回去送给妈妈吗？”

cells.en: Map shows three jars: one flower, one umbrella, one candy cane.
cells.cn: 地图上画着三个罐子：一朵花、一把雨伞、一根拐杖糖。

cells.en: “If we all dragon dance, he'll get out of the way!” says Dora.
cells.cn: “我们一起跳龙舞，他就会让开！”Dora 说。

cells.en: The red dragons dance away, and everyone cheers, “Yay!”
cells.cn: 红龙们跳着走开了，大家一起欢呼：“耶！”

cells.en: “So we need to look for white cones,” Dora tells the unicorn.
cells.cn: “所以我们要去找白色的锥子。”Dora 对独角兽说。

cells.en: “Oh, I love purple flowers!” Dora and Isa stand by the gate.
cells.cn: “噢，我喜欢紫色的花！”Dora 和 Isa 站在大门边。

cells.en: “Ooh, unicorn flowers!” Dora sees flowers near the unicorn's horn.
cells.cn: “哇，独角兽花！”Dora 看见独角兽角边上开满了花。

cells.en: Now all the unicorns have flowers, and they sing, “We did it!”
cells.cn: 现在所有独角兽都有花了，它们一起唱：“我们做到了！”

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Isa's Unicorn Flowers”.
ending: In the end, the unicorns give flowers to their mommy and everyone is happy. My favorite part is ______.
